title: State startup support — MPO did not track whether most of 914m CZK given via CzechInvest achieved anything
money_note: 914m CZK of state-budget, Recovery Plan and OP PIK money MPO gave CzechInvest for startup support (the audited volume), converted at 24.5 CZK/EUR as in nku-gacr-tacr
summary: NKU audit 25/22, published 5 October 2026, found that the Industry Ministry did not track for most audited projects whether the 914m CZK it routed through CzechInvest to support startups met its goals: for 276m CZK of Recovery Plan support it counted only the number of firms supported, and for 195m CZK of OP PIK support fewer than half of the startups reported data. CzechInvest also ran the 443m CZK Technology Incubation project through agency staff, which NKU rated an uneconomical extra cost of 21m CZK.
notes: Conclusion PDF parsed (SCANS.md demand-scan item 1). Responsible bodies: Ministerstvo prumyslu a obchodu (provider) and CzechInvest (recipient and implementer). Approved by the NKU Kolegium on 20 July 2026; published in the Vestnik table on 5.10.2026 (castka 4/2026) and in press release id15950 of the same day. Figures: 914m CZK audited; NPO projects Podpora podnikavosti, Internacionalizace and Digitalni regulacni piskoviste 276m CZK monitored only by number of supported entities; OP PIK project Podpora startupu 195m CZK with sustainability data from fewer than half of supported startups and sanctions never used; Technologicka inkubace 443m CZK, the only project with benefit monitoring; 21m CZK of agency commission and VAT rated uneconomical (breach of s. 39(3) Act 218/2000 by MPO). Same outcome-blindness shape as nku-gacr-tacr, nku-zdravotnicky-vyzkum and nku-zemedelsky-vyzkum. Urgency 0: a closed audit with no dated obligation. Recurrence 2: recurring programme funding.
quote: Zda došlo nebo dochází k naplnění stanovených cílů podpory, MPO u většiny kontrolovaných projektů nesledovalo.

title: Police uniform supply — 2.37bn CZK spent with no kit standard, surplus stock and unclaimed late-delivery penalties
money_note: 2,373.9m CZK the Interior Ministry spent on Police equipment and uniforms in 2018-2022 (the audited spend), converted at 24.5 CZK/EUR
summary: NKU audit 23/10, published 20 January 2025, found that the Interior Ministry spent 2,373.9m CZK on Police uniforms and kit in 2018-2022 without the kit standardisation it had promised since 2017, so it bought surplus stock in some items and ran short in others. In 8 of 12 sampled contracts it did not claim contractual penalties for late delivery, and part of the claims had lapsed by the time it acted.
notes: Conclusion PDF parsed during the 2026-10-05 dropped-log duty (INGEST.md 3c): the scripted nku card nku-k23010 was dropped at 0/0/0 on 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-28. Responsible body: Ministerstvo vnitra (Police equipment). Approved by the NKU Kolegium on 29 April 2024; published in the Vestnik table on 20.1.2025 (castka 1/2025). MV met none of the seven kit goals of the Police development concept to 2020 (government resolution 428/2017), including systemisation and standardisation that NKU already flagged in audit 17/07; the dispensing e-shop did not cut distribution costs; kit resale on the internet was not curbed. Scale 1: one ministry and one force. Urgency 0: closed audit, no dated obligation. Recurrence 2: continuous procurement.
quote: NKÚ na kontrolním vzorku 12 veřejných zakázek na pořízení výstroje zjistil, že MV při pozdním dodání výstroje u osmi z nich bez jakéhokoliv objektivního důvodu neuplatnilo a nevymáhalo smluvní pokuty.

title: Brownfield regeneration grants — budget-discipline breaches in 7 of 19 audited projects and no record of land regenerated
money_note: about 255m CZK, the financial volume of the 19 completed projects NKU audited under the MMR Brownfieldy I and SFPI Brownfieldy II programmes, converted at 24.5 CZK/EUR
summary: NKU audit 23/14, published 17 February 2025, found facts suggesting a breach of budget discipline in 7 of the 19 brownfield-regeneration projects it audited at 17 grant recipients (about 255m CZK), and doubts about value for money in three. The Regional Development Ministry counts only signed contracts, keeps no data on the area of brownfields regenerated, and missed two measures of its own national brownfield strategy.
notes: Conclusion PDF parsed during the 2026-10-05 dropped-log duty (INGEST.md 3c): scripted card nku-k23014 dropped at 0/0/0 on 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-28. Responsible bodies: Ministerstvo pro mistni rozvoj (subprogramme 117D082 Brownfieldy I) and Statni fond podpory investic (Brownfieldy II, government decree 496/2020). Approved by the NKU Kolegium on 20 May 2024; published in the Vestnik table on 17.2.2025 (castka 1/2025). The 7-of-19 budget-discipline sentence is split by a page footnote in the PDF, so the quote is the monitoring finding instead. Recipient-side evidence for p-0050-grant-recipient-clawbacks (municipal grant recipients). Scale 2: towns and regions regenerating brownfields. Urgency 0. Recurrence 2.
quote: NKÚ však hodnotí jako nedostatek, že MMR kromě počtu smluv neeviduje např. údaje o výměrách území brownfieldů a nevyhodnocuje údaje o územích již zrevitalizovaných díky poskytnuté podpoře.

title: Library digitisation grants — Culture Ministry paid 12.7m CZK over the legal cap and ran one inspection in seven years
money_note: 446.7m CZK the Culture Ministry spent supporting library digitisation and e-resources in 2017-2023 (state budget and Recovery Plan), converted at 24.5 CZK/EUR; the unlawful part is 12.7m CZK paid over the statutory limit
summary: NKU audit 24/03, published 3 March 2025, found that the Culture Ministry, which spent 446.7m CZK on library digitisation in 2017-2023, set goals too vague to evaluate, did not track the effects of its VISK grant programme and assessed applications non-transparently, with conflicted committee members left voting. It paid 12.7m CZK of grants above the legal limit, funded 24 projects in breach of the rules, and carried out a single public-administration inspection of VISK in seven years.
notes: Conclusion PDF parsed during the 2026-10-05 dropped-log duty (INGEST.md 3c): scripted card nku-k24003 dropped at 0/0/0 on 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-28. Responsible body: Ministerstvo kultury (VISK programme, 349.8m CZK of grants 2017-2023); also audited NK CR, MZK and NTK (CzechELib, 1,056.1m CZK, judged effective and economical). Approved by the NKU Kolegium on 16 December 2024; published in the Vestnik table on 3.3.2025 (castka 1/2025). 6,072 libraries in the Culture Ministry register. Provider-side grant-administration failure; adjacent to p-0050-grant-recipient-clawbacks. Scale 2: the library network. Urgency 0. Recurrence 2: annual grant rounds.
quote: Ministerstvo netransparentně hodnotilo žádosti, poskytovalo dotace v rozporu s nastavenými podmínkami a za sedm let provedlo pouze jednu veřejnosprávní kontrolu u programu VISK.

title: Social-services infrastructure grants — up to 19.1m CZK of suspected budget-discipline breaches and cars bought beyond need
money_note: 5,970m CZK of EU and state IROP support for social-services infrastructure in 2014-2024 (664 projects), converted at 24.5 CZK/EUR; the audited sample was 358m CZK across 14 projects and the suspected breaches total up to 19.1m CZK
summary: NKU audit 24/10, published 19 May 2025, reviewed IROP support for social-services infrastructure (5,970m CZK across 664 projects in 2014-2024) and found shortcomings at audited recipients suggesting budget-discipline breaches of up to 19.1m CZK, mostly in two projects it rated only partly purposeful. The conditions of one 2,505m CZK call let recipients buy cars in numbers that were in some cases not needed.
notes: Conclusion PDF parsed during the 2026-10-05 dropped-log duty (INGEST.md 3c): scripted card nku-k24010 dropped at 0/0/0 on 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-28. Responsible body: Ministerstvo pro mistni rozvoj as IROP managing authority; recipients audited include Oblastni charita Cerveny Kostelec, Charita Uhersky Brod, obec Borsice, Slezska diakonie and others (Armada spasy audit ended 18.9.2024 after the flood). Approved by the NKU Kolegium on 31 March 2025; published in the Vestnik table on 19.5.2025 (castka 3/2025). Recipient-side evidence for p-0050-grant-recipient-clawbacks (NGO and municipal recipients). Scale 2: social-service providers. Urgency 0. Recurrence 2.

title: Tender challenges at the competition office up by a third — 268 bidder proposals in 2025, 141 contract-signing bans
money_note: No budget is attached to the need; the 205m CZK of bidder deposits is market context, not a buyer's spend, and is not scored.
summary: The competition office ÚOHS says bidders filed 268 proposals to review live public tenders in 2025, up from 195 in 2024, and it ordered 141 interim measures. Its chairman blames poorly prepared tenders and over-engineered conditions that invite bidders to challenge them.
notes: MATCH 2026-10-05 (candidate A, owner decision 19 in docs/weekly/2026-09-28.md; the second evidence stream for the withdrawn ZZVZ review draft veklep-ALBSD65EF6FP). ÚOHS Výroční zpráva 2025, PDF CreationDate 2026-03-30, 63 pages, read 2026-10-05 via pdftotext. Návrhy: 268 in 2025 vs 195 in 2024; chairman: "nárůst podaných návrhů o více než třetinu". Průměrná délka řízení o návrhu v I. stupni 42 dní (first decision issued, not final); rozklady 164, 171 rozhodnutí předsedy, average 37 days from file hand-over; 109 confirmed. Předběžná opatření: 141 nařízeno, 25 zamítnuto. Kauce složené 205,029,319 Kč, propadlé 70,322,506 Kč. Chairman: interventions concern at most 2-3 % of tenders, mostly large ones; "odpovědnost za zákonné nastavení zadávacích podmínek leží na bedrech zadavatele". Dedup: grep uohs/přezkum in seen.txt -> only civic-uohs-metodika-nakup-leciv (a 2022 drug-buying guide), not this.
quote: V mnoha případech je na vině nekvalitní příprava zadávacích řízení, kdy zejména nedostatečně zpracované projekty nebo překombinované nastavení zadávacích podmínek přímo vyzývají k tomu, aby je dodavatelé napadali.
